summary: {parent} asks the parks office to price a whole sequence of lessons before committing a child to it.
realLife: Portland used a ten-lesson swim course to show families how different discount levels changed the amount due.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a course fee, number of lessons and the family's discount.

turns.pulledBy: The fee for the whole course rises beyond the family limit.
turns.what: The parent compares a later session with the one about to start.
turns.writesBack: The registration record shows whether the child enrolled.

turns.pulledBy: The lower fee covers the entire sequence within the family budget.
turns.what: The parent books the full course.
turns.writesBack: The receipt lists the session rather than a single visit.
